title: Tail latency from produce to consume
subtitle: p99 of send time to receive time for 100 B messages at a fixed send rate, log scale

rows.detail: p50 89.8 µs, p90 223.3 µs, p99.9 22.1 ms, max 46.7 ms. 10,000 messages, batch 1. Load average 11

caption: The slowest send rate without a flush has a worse tail than rates ten and fifty times higher. My unprofiled guess is thread wakeup cost when producer, broker and consumer park between messages. Shared Apple M4 Pro at a load average of 10 to 11, indicative only.
